summary: The FCC comment urges preservation of the E-Rate program, opposing any proposals to limit or sunset it, citing its importance for schools and libraries.

claims.argument: E-Rate program provides critical funding for schools and libraries
claims.evidence_quote: I am writing to urge the Federal Communications Commission to preserve and protect the E-Rate program and to oppose any proposal that would reduce, limit, or sunset this vital source of support for schools and libraries that millions of students depend on every single day.
